name: Sully Balloo's Letter
label: Quest
description: Recovered from a drowned skeleton beneath the shattered arches of the Thandol Span, this waterlogged letter contains the dying words of a dwarven soldier…
intro: Recovered from a drowned skeleton beneath the shattered arches of the Thandol Span, this waterlogged letter contains the dying words of a dwarven soldier named Sully Balloo. Addressed to his wife Sara in Ironforge, it carries the final thoughts of a defender lost beneath the icy river waters during the battles for the bridge.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The waterlogged and war-torn envelope dissolves in your hands, leaving you with a few pages of a letter in your grasp, written with painstaking care.
The letter is addressed to a Mrs. Sara Balloo of Ironforge and begins, "My dear Sara...."

clips.title: Progress
paras: You look as though you have traveled a great distance and seen much turmoil in your time, adventurer. These times we live in are trying on the soul. What news do you bring to me now?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You say you saw my Sully pinned beneath the icy waters? Say it isn't so!
Let me read what he wrote....

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
